bayts.text: I have turned all of me, possessed of nearness to Allah, intimate and beloved, possessed of longing for Allah.
Allah is greater than what I used to do, and I neither fear nor hope in any but Allah.
My remembrance, my gratitude, my good pleasure and my praise, with heart, body and pens, are for Allah.
All of me is for my Lord in secret and in the open, and I ask none but the Benefactor, Allah.
I am well pleased with a Beneficent, Everlasting One, and I thank Him unto the Gardens with my saying: "Praise belongs to Allah".
He protected me from harm by way of honour and turned toward me a benefit without burdens: so gratitude is for Allah.
Allah is greater than my creed and my deeds and my word: all of me has become good for Allah.
Allah has taken away what calls harm toward other than what has been chosen for me with my Lord, the Most Generous, for Allah.
His is the Existence that pre-eternity has already adorned, with permanence; and what is other than Allah belongs to Allah.
To Him be my gratitude and my praise, well pleased, and to Him my whole being forever: creation belongs to Allah.
He is the Generous Who led to me without toil what was chosen for me with Him: the affair belongs to Allah.
My pens have triumphed with the remembrance of Allah for a long time, and all of me has triumphed in the two Abodes, by Allah!
Allah leads to me in the two Abodes, well pleased with me, my wish, with the leading of the Expander (Al-Bāsiṭ), Allah.
He annihilated my haters without ever turning them toward my sides, possessed of reward with Allah.
My hand and my heart are His, His slave with good pleasure, possessed of service to the Messenger of Allah, through Allah.
O Lord, bless and grant peace forever, out of generosity, upon my supreme means of access to Allah.
the purest blessing with peace, beyond number, upon the Prophet, the Messenger, the slave of Allah,
Muḥammad, the best of those absent and those present, and the Family and the Companions, the party of the King, Allah.
I stretched out my hand to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and He extended to me from Himself the grace of the All-Embracing, Allah.
With a King, Beneficent, Kind, I am well pleased without displeasure, and with him who leads me to Allah through Allah.
A generosity has called my body to my remembrance and to gratitude, from Him through Whom all of me has become obedience to Allah.
I have turned all of me to Him Who frees from harm without cause, well pleased with the Lord of creation, Allah.
My religion toward the Garden is Islām, and it is above (every) other religion: and this is an (explicit) text from Allah (Qurʾān 3:19).
Allah gave me a Remembrance from Himself, and I accepted it from Him, possessed of nearness to Allah.
The peace of an Everlasting One upon the best of creation, and upon his party, and upon the one who longs for Allah.
